{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Actually, kind and gracious sir, if you talk of our wondrous far-speaking stick, the lizardflies are fond of metal trinkets.|Bazaar seller to Roark Garnet|<ref name="CP">''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]''</ref>}}
'''Lizardflies''' lived in the cliffs above the settlement of [[Outreachial]] on a [[Unidentified planet (Outreachial)|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They were attracted to shiny objects and stole them from visitors to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. A [[Unidentified bazaar seller|bazaar seller]] explained this to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] when he lost his third [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and believed it had been stolen by the native inhabitants.<ref name="CP" />
